lines.prompt: Reconstruct the entire netlist using only AND and NOT gates while preserving functional equivalence.

golden.reference: Reconstructed the netlist using only AND and NOT gates; 714 combinational gates were remapped to the AND/NOT basis and functional equivalence was preserved.
golden.notes: Response must claim success (and ideally equivalence). All four teams remapped exactly 714 gates (= 768 comb - 54 already-NOT), so 714 is a strong sanity anchor if a matched/remapped count is reported. Post-transform totals are team/implementation-dependent: Team2 delta +1738, Team3 delta +1835, Team7 after-count 3163 (916 AND + 2247 NOT), Team4 gave no counts. Any self-consistent post-transform count is acceptable; real verification is on the output netlist (only AND/NOT/DFF remain, equivalent to original).
